structured.answer: I didn't decide anything; I'll ask my son and the bank. The page does list all of Harel's tracks with their fees and 3- and 5-year returns. The only one that looked like my deposit was 'כספי (שקלי)', at about 4.25%–4.4% over 3 years with fees of about 0.5%. I couldn't tell if it is as safe as a פיקדון, and I don't understand the 1.47% 'מההפקדות' fee in some products.
